【原视频简介】
Our fall garden harvest is here, quiet and full all at once. It is the last big gathering before the vines turn and the light softens here on our six acres in Michigan.Come with us for a slow walk through the late summer garden while it is still giving. We gather tomatoes warm from the sun, beans and cucumbers tucked under tired leaves, potatoes from gentle soil, and a basket that feels like late August itself. This is not a tutorial, just time together in the country, noticing what the season has made and what it is ready to release. At the kitchen table we linger a little longer, turning over seed lists and small dreams for next year's garden, holding gratitude for what grew and hope for what will come after a good rest

00:00 A slow welcome to the late summer garden

We share slow living and country living from our Michigan homestead, with seasonal homemaking, cottage style touches, and the simple work of tending home through the year. If you love an unhurried look at homestead life, we are glad you are here.

Thank you for spending this tender end of summer with us.
